confidence_notes: Coffee, meal and draught-beer anchors rest on Annecy aggregates (Expatica/Numbeo-based and MyLifeElsewhere figures dated June to October 2026; some euro values were themselves converted from USD), seen only via search summaries, with a modest July uplift on coffee and meals. The 0.5 L draught is used as the standard beer serving. No dated Annecy cocktail price was found, so the cocktail is set a little under twice the beer anchor based on general knowledge of French bar pricing (low confidence). The wine glass sits within undated estimates of EUR 4 to 8. The four accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for peak July demand; no accommodation search or live listing check was done. Euro prices were converted to USD at an assumed EUR/USD near 1.16, not a sourced rate, so all USD values could shift with it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Annecy-specific aggregates, so no separate comparable city was needed; the cocktail uses the local beer relationship. Accommodation is reasoned from general knowledge of similar-sized French lakeside and Alpine resort towns at summer peak; no comparable-city search was run.
